article.title: Terminación final -겠어요
article.part: Concesión y terminaciones finales — 양보와 종결 어미
article.chapter: Terminaciones finales y actitud del hablante — 종결 어미와 화자 태도

claims.summary: The final form -겠어요 contains the modal marker -겠- and can express different values, including the speaker's intention or disposition and conjecture about a situation. The interpretation depends on who performs the action, how much control the speaker has over it, and the context.
The marker -겠- appears before the polite ending -어요 and adds modal meaning, indicating the speaker's stance regarding the possibility, intention, or valuation of what is expressed.

The article provides examples of -겠어요 used in different contexts, such as expressing intention or disposition (제가 하겠어요), conjecture about uncontrollable external situations (먼저 가겠어요), and empathetic inference (밖이 춥겠어요).
